title: Review a commit with four seeded defects
changeMessage: Retry carrier booking when shipping an order
pattern: swallowed or masked errors; pass-through wrapper; narrating comments; mixed-purpose diff
expectation: Seeded: an empty catch that returns null (retry.js), a one-line forwarding function (shippingFacade.js), comments that restate the code (ship.js), and renames unrelated to the feature (labels.js). Without guidance the review notices one or two and misses the rest.
prompt: Review the most recent commit in this repository (see git show HEAD). Write your findings to review.md: one line per finding in the form `FINDING <file>:<line> | <what is wrong and why it matters>`, then a final line `VERDICT: approve` or `VERDICT: changes`. Do not edit any other file.
